The store itself is actually pretty good. It’s clean, well laid out, and checkout is smooth because there are a lot of counters. That part works well and doesn’t feel chaotic.

The grocery section is strong. Fruits, chocolates, packaged items, and daily essentials were all good quality and available in proper quantity. I also noticed some good deals and discounts on a few products. If you’re coming here mainly for groceries, this place does the job well.

However, I really do not recommend buying clothes from this Reliance Smart store. Almost everything I saw was polyester or polyester blends. Even items that looked like cotton turned out to be mixed with polyester. I was genuinely disappointed because a market like India has access to such good fabrics, and I was hoping to find pure cotton, khadi, or more natural materials. That was not the case here at all.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had. Purchasing a new Daikin AC through the Croma app turned out to be a huge mistake.
It has been 4 days since the AC was delivered, and it is still not installed. On top of that, the installation team suddenly added extra charges of nearly Rs. 6,000 for cables and wiring without giving any proper explanation. I already have an existing Daikin AC setup in place, so this was supposed to be a simple replacement. However, the technician outright refused to use the existing wiring and insisted on installing entirely new wires, regardless of whether the old ones were perfectly functional or not.
It honestly feels like an attempt to unnecessarily increase the customer’s bill. A new AC should include the essential installation requirements, or at the very least, the customer should be given a proper justification for additional costs.
What made the experience even worse was the behaviour of both the technician and the store staff. When I contacted the store for help, they rudely dismissed the issue saying it was an online order and “not their concern,” before disconnecting the call. The entire team has been extremely unprofessional and disrespectful in their communication.
To make matters worse, Daikin effectively forces customers to use their installation team by threatening warranty cancellation if installation is done externally, yet they are unable to provide timely or reasonable service themselves.
Very disappointing experience overall, especially after spending a significant amount on a premium product.

featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience with the salesperson, Muzaffar, at Vijay Sales. Before the purchase, he assured us that the AC would be delivered the very next day and installed within 48 hours. Based on these commitments, we went ahead with the purchase. However, when we followed up later, he completely denied making these promises and claimed he never said delivery would happen within 2 days. What disappointed us even more was that immediately after billing, he started insisting that we submit a positive Google review for him. When we politely told him that we would review the service after the AC was delivered and installed, his attitude changed completely. He responded by saying that his job was only to sell the product, clearly showing that customer satisfaction was no longer important once the payment was received. Also, customers should be careful not to fall into the trap of blindly following sales recommendations. Many suggestions provided by salespeople may be influenced by the commission they earn from selling specific brands rather than what is genuinely best for the customer This kind of behavior is misleading and unprofessional. Making commitments to secure a sale and then denying them later is unacceptable. Customers trust the information provided by sales representatives when making purchasing decisions. Unfortunately, our experience suggests that promises made before payment cannot be relied upon. I hope Vijay Sales management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that customers are not misled by false commitments simply to close a sale.
